head: Custos
sub:
Your agent can rewrite its own harness.
It can never grade its own homework.
foot: Built at the Harness Engineering & Model Wrangling hackathon  ·  MongoDB Atlas  ·  github.com/sidsanc/custos
say: Self-improving agents already cheat: o3 stubbed its own scorer. Custos lets an agent rewrite its own harness, but never grade its own homework.

head: MongoDB Atlas is the boundary
sub:
Agent = restricted Atlas user: read failures, insert proposals. Nothing else.
RBAC  ·  $jsonSchema provenance  ·  change stream referee
Sealed holdout  ·  transactional promotion  ·  time-series metrics
say: The agent is a restricted Atlas user that can only insert proposals. A privileged referee watches them through a change stream, scores each on a sealed holdout, and promotes winners in a transaction.

title: python redteam.py   # same credentials as the agent
say: First, a red team with the agent's own credentials. Rewriting its harness, or reading the answer key: Atlas says not authorized. Self-acceptance, or a rule without provenance: the schema validator refuses. Deleting a guardrail, or granting write access: the referee rejects it. Seven for seven.

title: python agent.py 5   # honest self-improvement
say: Then honest self-improvement. Three proposals fail to generalise and are rejected. The fourth takes the score from two to fifteen out of sixteen. The next regresses on unseen questions, and is rejected.

title: python retire.py   # removal is a first-class change
say: Finally, retirement ablates every rule. This one stays, because removing it hurts the sealed holdout.

head: Governed recursive self-improvement
sub:
Every version, verdict and score lives in MongoDB.
Every proposal streams to Raindrop as a self-improvement event.
say: Every version and verdict lives in MongoDB, and streams to Raindrop. Custos: governed recursive self-improvement.
